title: Benchmark Lab: rich Past Runs metadata/hover, All/Completed/Failed card filter, and pytest run isolation

sections.what: Upgrade /bench Past Benchmark Runs with full run metadata (date + time, provider, area, pass/fail counts) and hover config details, add an All/Completed/Failed filter to the results toolbar, and isolate pytest benchmark runs from data/model_bench/runs/.
sections.why: Past Benchmark Runs currently only shows character, model count, run_id, and time-of-day (plus leaked pytest fixtures like test_run_123), making it hard to tell runs apart, and large 20-60 model sweeps need a quick filter to isolate failed or completed cards.
sections.how:
1. Extend GET /api/bench/runs in routes/benchmark.py to return date/time, provider host/profile, area/scenario, completed/failed counts, config snapshot, and top model summary.
2. Upgrade Past Benchmark Runs rendering in static/js/benchmark/benchmark.js with richer row metadata and hover tooltip/popover details.
3. Add an All / Completed / Failed status filter control with live counts to the results toolbar in templates/benchmark.html and benchmark.js.
4. Patch tests/test_benchmark_routes.py to isolate BENCH_DIR/RUNS_DIR into tmp_path and remove leaked test_run_123 / test_rate_run_999 files.
sections.verify: 1. Run python -m pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py -q.\n2. Verify /bench Past Runs metadata, hover tooltip, and All/Completed/Failed filter live in browser.

acceptance.text: Past Benchmark Runs list displays character, date + time, provider/host badge, completed/failed counts (e.g. 58/63 ok), and scenario/area name, with a hover tooltip/popover showing full run config (temperature, max_tokens, reasoning_effort, reasoning_max_tokens, preferred_action, top-scoring model)
Benchmark Lab results toolbar includes a live status filter (All / Completed / Failed) with counts to filter rendered model cards in place
tests/test_benchmark_routes.py isolates run storage in tmp_path so pytest never leaks test_run_* files into data/model_bench/runs/, and existing stray test run files are removed
Zero em-dashes and pytest tests/test_benchmark_routes.py passes

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: /bench (Past Benchmark Runs sidebar list and results toolbar beside Export JSON / Diff Compare).

Current availability: Past Benchmark Runs only shows character, model count, run_id, and time; results grid has no All/Completed/Failed filter.

Live verification steps:
1. Open /bench and inspect Past Benchmark Runs.
   - expected: Each row shows character, date + time, provider badge, pass/fail count, and area; hovering shows full config details.
2. Load a run with mixed completed and failed models and toggle All / Completed / Failed in the results toolbar.
   - expected: Card grid filters cleanly to matching cards with accurate counts.
